item.title: BRP Deploys AI Proof‑of‑Concept to Optimize Manufacturing and Cut Costs
item.description:
BRP Deploys AI Proof‑of‑Concept to Optimize Manufacturing and Cut Costs

BRP’s Chief Information Officer Stéphane Bilodeau explains how the company used AI to tackle a manufacturing inefficiency that traditional methods could not solve.

🔍 Overview

  • AI strategy is defined as solving complex problems that are worth solving.
  • The focus is on problems where traditional approaches have not worked and where the outcome creates meaningful business value.
  • AI is treated as a strategic capability that requires strong internal teams and selective external partners.

🤖 AI Project Details

  • The team first spent time understanding the data and the process.
  • A proof of concept was built within a few weeks.
  • Weekly governance asks two questions: Is the problem still worth solving? and Can we solve it?.
  • If either answer is no, the effort stops – reasons may include insufficient data or missing technology.
  • Upon completion, finance validates the results and the business decides on deployment.

📈 Business Impact

  • The AI solution delivered a significant optimization.
  • In financial terms, significant savings were realized across all manufacturing sites.

🛠️ Implementation Approach

  • AI projects follow the broader IT principle of asking does it work? before scaling.
  • Predictability is valued: stable systems, consistent service quality, and on‑time, on‑budget delivery.
  • Success is measured by the ability to solve the problem reliably, not just by the sophistication of the AI.

💡 Why It Matters

  • The initiative shows that progress with AI is gradual but the benefits are real.
  • It acknowledges the hype cycle around AI and the expectation of immediate massive gains.
  • It highlights a major unknown: AI is the first invention capable of improving itself.
  • By embedding AI as a strategic capability, BRP strengthens its digital backbone that supports every function from design to distribution.

#BRP #AI #Manufacturing #DigitalTransformation #AIstrategy

Source: How IT is driving innovation, resilience, and AI at BRP

item.title: Gemtek and Dixon expand India joint venture for optical connectivity manufacturing
item.description:
Gemtek and Dixon expand India joint venture for optical connectivity manufacturing

Gemtek Technology Co., Ltd. and Dixon Technologies (India) Limited are advancing their strategic collaboration through their joint venture in India, expanding manufacturing and market opportunities for optical connectivity solutions.

🔍 Overview

The collaboration combines capabilities from both companies:

  • Gemtek: expertise in optical communications, photonic integration and product development
  • Dixon: manufacturing scale, supply-chain capabilities and market presence in India

Together they are creating a scalable platform to serve Broadband, Telecom, Cloud, Data Center and AI Infrastructure markets in India and globally.

⚙️ Key details

Gemtek is expanding its optical connectivity portfolio:

  • Solutions spanning 1G to 1.6T
  • Product types: Optical Transceivers, SFPs, BOSA and high-speed optical connectivity solutions
  • Leveraging EIC-PIC photonic integration and advanced manufacturing capabilities
  • Advancing roadmap toward 800G, 1.6T and next-generation photonic integration technologies

The partnership addresses growing demand for high-bandwidth and high-performance connectivity driven by AI, cloud and data center infrastructure.

🏭 Manufacturing focus

The collaboration supports India’s growing focus on local manufacturing of:

  • Optical Transceivers
  • BOSA (Bidirectional Optical Sub-Assembly)
  • Other high-speed optical solutions

By combining Gemtek’s technology and product development expertise with Dixon’s local manufacturing and supply-chain capabilities, the partnership enables scalable production in India while complementing Gemtek’s global manufacturing footprint, strengthening geographic diversification and overall supply-chain resilience.

🚀 Availability

Event Details
India Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026 October 7-10, 2026
Location Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, India
Hall/Booth Hall 2, Booth B1

Gemtek will showcase its 1G-to-1.6T Optical Connectivity portfolio and solutions for Broadband, Telecom and AI Data Center applications, including Optical Transceivers, BOSA and next-generation high-speed optical connectivity technologies.

👥 About the companies

Company Description
Gemtek Technology Global provider of networking and communications solutions across Broadband, Wi-Fi, Fiber, 5G, Optical Connectivity and AI-enabled Networking; combines photonic integration, product innovation and advanced manufacturing capabilities
Dixon Technologies (India) Limited Leading Indian design-focused and manufacturing company serving consumer electronics, telecommunications, IT hardware and other technology sectors; extensive capabilities in product design, engineering, large-scale manufacturing and supply-chain management
